tldr: Uranus through the 6th house disrupts work, health, stress, routines, and daily maintenance.
body:
When Uranus moves through your 6th house, it interrupts the usual pattern around work, health, stress, routines, chores, habits, exhaustion, and what has become hard to maintain. You may notice the condition of your days more clearly: what is sustainable, what is draining you, and what your body keeps trying to report.

You may need more space, honesty, freedom, experimentation, or a break from the old setup. It can help you see where the current pattern has become too small or too false.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for adjusting a routine before it becomes a bigger problem.

The caution: Watch for changing everything just to get relief from one pressure point. The risk is treating stress as normal just because you have learned how to keep functioning through it.

Uranus moves through this house for a long chapter. Give change room without throwing away the parts of life that still matter.
